prime_contract: Supplied prime values are identified premises; no primality testing.
order: increasing low residue, then high-part trailing-zero count, then lexicographic free bitstring; not numerical integer order

prime_input.transfer: literal seven-value array only; no CRT/local/suffix or original prime-prefix computation

formal.definition: prime plus at most k powers, exponent multiset of naturals

provenance.scope: All 70-bit integers, selected-prime minimum and complete optimal-prime fiber only; block order is not numeric; no global lower bound from palette-restricted failure.
provenance.primary: Retained extracted Erdős 1977 section 3, printed p.50; no image payload/visual reading; exact repeat/zero/empty conventions from Formal10.
